ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: To effectively carry out labor education on campus, the Dongfanghong School utilized a piece of land with an area of unit 1 denoted by $\triangle ABC$, located on the southeast side of the school next to the wall. This land was divided into three parts for the seventh, eighth, and ninth grades, as shown in the diagram. Within $\triangle ABC$, point P is any point on side $BC$ (excluding points B and C), and the vertices F and E of rectangle $AFPE$ are respectively on sides $AB$ and $AC$. The area for the seventh grade corresponds to rectangle $AFPE$, while the eighth and ninth grades ocupy areas $\triangle PEC$ and $\triangle BPF$, respectively. If $BP: PC = 2:3$, what is the area of $\triangle BPF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $AFPE$ is a rectangle, \\
hence $PF\parallel CA$, \\
hence $\triangle BFP\sim \triangle BAC$, \\
since $BP\colon PC=2\colon 3$, \\
hence $BP\colon BC=2\colon 5$, \\
hence $\frac{{S}_{\triangle BFP}}{{S}_{\triangle BAC}}=\frac{4}{25}$, \\
since ${S}_{\triangle ABC}=1$, \\
hence ${S}_{\triangle BFP}=\boxed{\frac{4}{25}}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached diagram shows a large triangle ABC with B and C on the bottom side BC and A at the top. Point P lies on side BC between B and C. Point F lies on side AB, point E lies on side AC, and the segments FP and PE are drawn inside the triangle. Thus triangle BPF is inside triangle ABC, with BF lying along BA and BP lying along BC; the side FP is drawn in the direction parallel to AC, consistent with AFPE being a rectangle. Reasoning: Since AFPE is a rectangle, opposite sides are parallel, so FP is parallel to AE. Because E lies on AC, AE is along AC, hence FP is parallel to AC. Therefore triangle BPF is similar to triangle BAC: BF corresponds to BA, BP corresponds to BC, and FP corresponds to AC. Given BP:PC = 2:3, we have BP:BC = 2:(2+3) = 2:5. Similar triangles have area ratio equal to the square of the corresponding side ratio, so S(BPF)/S(ABC) = (BP/BC)^2 = (2/5)^2 = 4/25. Since S(ABC) = 1, S(BPF) = 4/25.
